race.comment: DIGGERS SHOUT (2) trialled well coming in and had some support on debut when tackling a Saturday race where he wasn't disgraced. Now back to an easier assignment as he takes on the older horses, though Pike sticks and he should be better for the fresh run. Can land the knockout blow. PROFIT GAL (11) is a half-sister to the handy Madhi Girl on debut with some nice trials under her belt, the latest behind subsequent midweek winner Properata. Will need a touch of luck from the barrier, but has shown enough to suggest she can feature in the finish on debut. CLEAR ASSAULT (10) comes through the same trial as PROFIT GAL and beat her home that day. The inside barrier is a big tick and that's already proven to be a strong form reference. Won't be far away. SAFE AND SOUND (8) has shown ability at the trials and a forward showing is expected. ROCKTEX (3) can feature in the finish first-up.
